title.raw: 卷十一 本紀第十一: 聖宗二 Volume 11 Annals 11: Shengzong 2

sentences.zh: 聖宗二

translations.literal: Shengzong, Part Two
translations.idiomatic: Shengzong, Part Two

sentences.zh: 四年春正月甲戌，觀漁土河。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on jiaxu day, watched fishing at the Tuhu River.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Tonghe, on jiaxu day of the first spring month, the Emperor watched fishing at the Tuhu River.

sentences.zh: 林牙耶律謀魯姑、彰德軍節度使蕭闥覽上東征俘獲，賜詔獎諭。

translations.literal: Yulin Yelü Molugu and Zhangde Army military commissioner Xiao Talan submitted captives from the eastern campaign; an edict praised and commended them.
translations.idiomatic: Yulin Yelü Molugu and Zhangde Army military commissioner Xiao Talan reported captives from the eastern campaign; an edict commended them.

sentences.zh: 丙子，樞密使耶律斜軫、林牙勤德等上討女直所獲生口十餘萬、馬二十餘萬及諸物。

translations.literal: On bingzi day Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelü Xiezhen, yulin Qinde, and others submitted more than a hundred thousand captives, more than two hundred thousand horses, and other goods taken in the campaign against the Jurchen.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelü Xiezhen, yulin Qinde, and others reported more than a hundred thousand captives, more than two hundred thousand horses, and other goods taken in the Jurchen campaign.

sentences.zh: 己卯，朝皇太后。

translations.literal: On jimao day the Emperor paid court to the Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day the Emperor attended court before the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 決滯訟。

translations.literal: Pending lawsuits were decided.
translations.idiomatic: The court cleared backlogged lawsuits.

sentences.zh: 壬午，樞密使斜軫、林牙勤德、謀魯姑、節度使闥覽、統軍使室羅、侍中抹只、奚王府監軍迪烈與安吉等克女直還軍，遣近侍泥裏吉詔旌其功，仍執手撫諭，賜酒果勞之。

translations.literal: On renwu day Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiezhen, yulin Qinde, Molugu, military commissioner Talan, army commander Shiluo, Palace Attendant Mojie, Xi princely house overseer Dilie, and Anji and others, having conquered the Jurchen and returned with the army, were sent the attendant Niliji with an edict to commend their merit; he still clasped hands and comforted them, and granted wine and fruit to reward them.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiezhen, yulin Qinde, Molugu, military commissioner Talan, army commander Shiluo, Palace Attendant Mojie, Xi princely house overseer Dilie, and Anji and others, having broken the Jurchen and returned, were sent the attendant Niliji with an edict commending their merit; he clasped their hands in reassurance, granted wine and fruit, and rewarded them.

sentences.zh: 甲午，幸長濼。

translations.literal: On jiawu day the court visited Changbiao.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the Emperor went to Changbiao.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅，以四番都統軍李繼忠為檢校司徒、上柱國。

translations.literal: In the second month, on renyin day, Fourth Banner supreme army commander Li Jizhong was made honorary Sikong and Grand Pillar of State.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day in the second month Li Jizhong, supreme army commander of the fourth banner, was granted honorary Sikong and Grand Pillar of State.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，西夏李繼遷叛宋來降，以為定難軍節度使、銀夏綏宥等州觀察處置等使、特進檢校太師、都督夏州諸軍事。

translations.literal: On guimao day Li Jiqian of Western Xia rebelled against Song and came to submit; he was appointed Dingnan Army military commissioner, commissioner for the observation and disposition of Yin, Xia, Sui, and You prefectures, specially advanced honorary Grand Preceptor, and commander-in-chief of all military affairs in Xia Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Li Jiqian of Western Xia defected from Song and submitted; he was made Dingnan Army military commissioner, commissioner for the observation and disposition of Yin, Xia, Sui, and You prefectures, specially advanced honorary grand preceptor, and commander-in-chief of all military affairs in Xia Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 西番酋帥瓦泥乞移為保大軍節度使、鄜坊等州觀察處置等使。

translations.literal: Western Tribes chieftain Waniqiyi was made Baoda Army military commissioner and commissioner for the observation and disposition of Fufang and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Tribes chieftain Waniqiyi was appointed Baoda Army military commissioner and commissioner for the observation and disposition of Fufang and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，耶律斜軫、蕭闥覽、謀魯姑等族帥來朝，行飲至之禮，賞賚有差。

translations.literal: On jiayin day Yelü Xiezhen, Xiao Talan, Molugu, and other tribal chiefs came to court; the yinzhi rite was performed; rewards were granted in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Yelü Xiezhen, Xiao Talan, Molugu, and other tribal chiefs came to court; the court performed the yinzhi rite and rewarded them according to rank.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，行次裊裏井。

translations.literal: On bingyin day the court halted at Naolijing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the court encamped at Naolijing.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌，於越休哥奏宋遣曹彬、崔彥進、米信由雄州道，田重進飛狐道，潘美、楊繼業雁門道來侵，岐溝、涿州、固安、新城皆陷。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiaxu day, yuyue Xiuge memorialized that Song had sent Cao Bin, Cui Yanjin, and Mi Xin by the Xiongzhou route, Tian Chongjin by the Feihu route, and Pan Mei and Yang Jiye by the Yanmen route to invade; Qigou, Zhuo Prefecture, Gu'an, and Xincheng had all fallen.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiaxu day, yuyue Xiuge reported that Song had sent Cao Bin, Cui Yanjin, and Mi Xin by the Xiongzhou route, Tian Chongjin by the Feihu route, and Pan Mei and Yang Jiye by the Yanmen route to invade; Qigou, Zhuo Prefecture, Gu'an, and Xincheng had all fallen.

sentences.zh: 詔宣徽使蒲領馳赴燕南，與休哥議軍事；

translations.literal: An edict ordered Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling to ride swiftly to southern Yan to consult with Xiuge on military affairs;
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling to ride at once to southern Yan to consult with Xiuge on military affairs;

sentences.zh: 分遣使者征諸部兵益休哥以擊之；

translations.literal: envoys were dispatched separately to levy troops from the various divisions to reinforce Xiuge and strike the enemy;
translations.idiomatic: envoys were sent separately to levy troops from the various divisions to reinforce Xiuge and strike the invaders;

sentences.zh: 復遣東京留守耶律抹只以大軍繼進，賜劍專殺。

translations.literal: Eastern Capital regent Yelü Mojie was again sent with the main army to follow up, and was granted a sword authorizing summary execution.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Capital regent Yelü Mojie was again ordered forward with the main army, and was granted a sword authorizing summary execution.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以親征告陵廟、山川。

translations.literal: On yihai day notification of the personal campaign was sent to the mausoleums, temples, and mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day the court notified the imperial mausoleums, temples, and mountains and rivers that the Emperor would campaign in person.

sentences.zh: 丙子，統軍使耶律頗德敗宋軍於固安，休哥絕其糧餉，擒將吏，獲馬牛、器仗甚眾。

translations.literal: On bingzi day army commander Yelü Pide defeated the Song army at Gu'an; Xiuge cut off their grain supply, captured officers, and seized very many horses, cattle, and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day army commander Yelü Pide routed the Song army at Gu'an; Xiuge cut off their supplies, captured officers, and seized vast numbers of horses, cattle, and weapons.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，寰州刺史趙彥章以城叛，附於宋。

translations.literal: On gengchen day Huan Prefecture prefect Zhao Yanzhang rebelled with the city and went over to Song.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Huan Prefecture prefect Zhao Yanzhang surrendered the city and defected to Song.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，宋兵入涿州。

translations.literal: On xinsi day Song troops entered Zhuo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Song forces entered Zhuo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 順義軍節度副使趙希贊以朔州叛，附於宋。

translations.literal: Shunyi Army deputy military commissioner Zhao Xizan rebelled with Shuozhou and went over to Song.
translations.idiomatic: Shunyi Army deputy military commissioner Zhao Xizan surrendered Shuozhou and defected to Song.

sentences.zh: 時上與皇太后駐兵駝羅口，詔趣東征兵馬以為應援。

translations.literal: At that time the Emperor and the Empress Dowager were encamped at Tuoluokou; an edict urged the eastern levies to march as reinforcements.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Emperor and the Empress Dowager were encamped at Tuoluokou; an edict ordered the eastern levies to hurry forward as reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔林牙勤德以兵守平州之海岸以備宋。

translations.literal: On renwu day an edict ordered yulin Qinde to hold the Pingzhou coast with troops against Song.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict ordered yulin Qinde to hold the Pingzhou coast with troops against Song.

sentences.zh: 仍報平州節度使迪裏姑，若勤德未至，遣人趣行；

translations.literal: Pingzhou military commissioner Diligu was also notified that if Qinde had not yet arrived, men should be sent to urge him on;
translations.idiomatic: Pingzhou military commissioner Diligu was also told that if Qinde had not yet arrived, men should be sent to hurry him forward;

sentences.zh: 馬乏則括民馬；

translations.literal: if horses were lacking, civilian horses were to be requisitioned;
translations.idiomatic: if horses ran short, civilian horses were to be requisitioned;

sentences.zh: 鎧甲闕，則取於顯州之甲坊。

translations.literal: if armor was lacking, it was to be taken from the armory at Xian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: if armor ran short, it was to be taken from the armory at Xian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸未，遼軍與宋田重進戰於飛狐，不利，冀州防禦使大鵬翼、康州刺史馬赟、馬軍指揮使何萬通陷焉。

translations.literal: On guiwei day the Liao army fought Tian Chongjin of Song at Feihu with an unfavorable outcome; Jizhou defense commissioner Da Pengyi, Kang Prefecture prefect Ma Yun, and cavalry commander He Wantong were captured.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day the Liao army fought Tian Chongjin of Song at Feihu and was defeated; Jizhou defense commissioner Da Pengyi, Kang Prefecture prefect Ma Yun, and cavalry commander He Wantong were taken.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以北院樞密使耶律斜軫為山西兵馬都統，以北院宣徽使蒲領為南征都統，以副於越休哥。

translations.literal: On dinghai day Northern Court Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelü Xiezhen was made overall commander of Shanxi horses and troops, Northern Court Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling was made overall commander of the southern campaign, and both were made deputies to yuyue Xiuge.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Northern Court Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelü Xiezhen was made overall commander of Shanxi horses and troops, Northern Court Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling was made overall commander of the southern campaign, and both served as deputies to yuyue Xiuge.

sentences.zh: 彰國軍節度使艾正、觀察判官宋雄以應州叛，附於宋。

translations.literal: Zhangguo Army military commissioner Ai Zheng and administrative aide Song Xiong rebelled with Ying Prefecture and went over to Song.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangguo Army military commissioner Ai Zheng and administrative aide Song Xiong surrendered Ying Prefecture and defected to Song.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，遣飛龍使亞剌、文班吏亞達哥閱馬以給先發諸軍，詔駙馬都尉蕭繼遠領之。

translations.literal: On gengyin day Flying Dragon envoy Yala and clerical officer Yadage were sent to inspect horses to supply the armies going out first; an edict put Imperial Son-in-law Commander Xiao Jiyuan in charge.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Flying Dragon envoy Yala and clerical officer Yadage were sent to inspect horses for the armies marching out first; an edict put Imperial Son-in-law Commander Xiao Jiyuan in charge.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，武定軍馬步軍都指揮使、郢州防禦使呂行德、副都指揮使張繼從、馬軍都指揮使劉知進等以飛狐叛，附於宋。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Wuding Army cavalry-and-infantry commander and Ying Prefecture defense commissioner Lü Xingde, deputy commander Zhang Jicong, and cavalry commander Liu Zhijin and others rebelled with Feihu and went over to Song.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Wuding Army cavalry-and-infantry commander and Ying Prefecture defense commissioner Lü Xingde, deputy commander Zhang Jicong, cavalry commander Liu Zhijin, and others surrendered Feihu and defected to Song.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，賜林牙謀魯姑旗鼓四、劍一，率禁軍之驍銳者南助休哥。

translations.literal: On guisi day yulin Molugu was granted four flags and drums and one sword, and was to lead the elite of the forbidden army south to assist Xiuge.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day yulin Molugu was granted four sets of flags and drums and one sword, and ordered to lead the elite of the forbidden army south to assist Xiuge.

sentences.zh: 丙申，步軍都指揮使穆超以靈丘叛，附於宋。

translations.literal: On bingshen day infantry commander Mu Chao rebelled with Lingqiu and went over to Song.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day infantry commander Mu Chao surrendered Lingqiu and defected to Song.

sentences.zh: 詔遣使賜樞密使斜軫密旨及彰國軍節度使杓窊印以趣征討。

translations.literal: An edict dispatched envoys to grant Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiezhen secret instructions and the seal of Zhangguo Army military commissioner Shaowa to hasten the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent envoys to give Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiezhen secret instructions and the seal of Zhangguo Army military commissioner Shaowa to hurry the campaign.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥朔，次南京北郊。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the jihai new moon, the court halted at the northern suburbs of Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai new moon of the fourth summer month the court encamped at the northern suburbs of Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 庚子，惕隱瑤升、西南面招討使韓德威以捷報。

translations.literal: On gengzi day tihu Yaosheng and Southwest Route pacification commissioner Han Dewei reported victory.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day tihu Yaosheng and Southwest Route pacification commissioner Han Dewei reported victory.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，宋潘美陷雲州。

translations.literal: On xinchou day Pan Mei of Song captured Yun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Pan Mei of Song took Yun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，遣抹只、謀魯姑、勤德等領偏師以助休哥，仍賜旗鼓、杓窊印撫諭將校。

translations.literal: On renyin day Mojie, Molugu, Qinde, and others were sent to lead detached forces to assist Xiuge, and were again granted flags and drums and the Shaowa seal to comfort and instruct the officers.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Mojie, Molugu, Qinde, and others were ordered to lead detached forces to assist Xiuge, and were again granted flags and drums and the Shaowa seal to reassure the officers.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，休哥復以捷報，上以酒脯祭天地。

translations.literal: On guimao day Xiuge again reported victory; the Emperor used wine and dried meat to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Xiuge again reported victory; the Emperor offered wine and dried meat in sacrifice to heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 率群臣賀於皇太后。

translations.literal: Leading the ministers, he congratulated the Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: He led the ministers in offering congratulations to the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 詔勤德還軍。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Qinde to return with the army.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Qinde to withdraw the army.

sentences.zh: 丙午，頗德上所獲鎧仗數。

translations.literal: On bingwu day Pide submitted the count of captured armor and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Pide submitted the tally of captured armor and weapons.

sentences.zh: 戊申，監軍、宣徽使蒲領奏敵軍引退，而奚王籌寧、北大王蒲奴寧、統軍使頗德等以兵追躡，皆勝之。

translations.literal: On wushen day overseer and Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling memorialized that the enemy army had withdrawn, while Xi King Chouning, Northern Court Great King Pununing, army commander Pide, and others pursued with troops and all were victorious.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day overseer and Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling reported that the enemy had withdrawn, while Xi King Chouning, Northern Court Great King Pununing, army commander Pide, and others pursued and all won victories.

sentences.zh: 遣敞史勤德持詔褒美，及詔侍中抹只統諸軍赴行在所。

translations.literal: Changshi Qinde was sent with an edict to praise them, and an edict also ordered Palace Attendant Mojie to command the armies and proceed to the imperial camp.
translations.idiomatic: Changshi Qinde was sent with an edict commending them, and Palace Attendant Mojie was ordered to command the armies and proceed to the imperial camp.

sentences.zh: 頻不部節度使和盧睹、黃皮室詳穩解裏等各上所獲兵甲。

translations.literal: Pinbu division military commissioner Heluqu, Huangpishi xiangwen Jieli, and others each submitted captured armor and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: Pinbu division military commissioner Heluqu, Huangpishi xiangwen Jieli, and others each submitted captured arms and armor.

sentences.zh: 又詔兩部突騎赴蔚州，以助闥覽。

translations.literal: An edict again ordered two divisions of tuqi cavalry to go to Weizhou to assist Talan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict again ordered two divisions of tuqi cavalry to march to Weizhou to assist Talan.

sentences.zh: 橫帳郎君老君奴率諸郎君巡僥居庸之北。

translations.literal: Horizontal tent langjun Laojunnu led the langjun to patrol north of Juyong.
translations.idiomatic: Horizontal tent langjun Laojunnu led the langjun in patrolling north of Juyong.

sentences.zh: 將軍化哥統平州兵馬，橫帳郎君奴哥為黃皮室都監，郎君謁裏為北府都監，各以步兵赴蔚州以助斜軫。

translations.literal: General Huage commanded Pingzhou horses and troops; horizontal tent langjun Nuge was made Huangpishi overseer, and langjun Yeli was made Northern Court overseer; each led infantry to Weizhou to assist Xiezhen.
translations.idiomatic: General Huage commanded Pingzhou horses and troops; horizontal tent langjun Nuge was made Huangpishi overseer and langjun Yeli Northern Court overseer; each led infantry to Weizhou to assist Xiezhen.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以斜軫為諸路兵馬都統，闥覽兵馬副部署，迪子都監。

translations.literal: On gengxu day Xiezhen was made overall commander of horses and troops on all routes, Talan deputy camp commander for horses and troops, and Dizi army overseer,
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Xiezhen was made overall commander of horses and troops on all routes, Talan deputy camp commander for horses and troops, and Dizi army overseer,

sentences.zh: 以代善補、韓德威。

translations.literal: replacing Daishanbu and Han Dewei.
translations.idiomatic: replacing Daishanbu and Han Dewei.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以艾正、趙希贊及應州、朔州節度副使奚軍小校隘離轄、渤海小校貫海等叛入於宋，籍其家屬，分賜有功將校。

translations.literal: On guichou day, because Ai Zheng, Zhao Xizan, and Ying and Shuo deputy military commissioners Xi army junior officer Aililixia, Bohai junior officer Guanhai, and others had rebelled and entered Song, their households were registered and distributed as rewards to meritorious officers.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, because Ai Zheng, Zhao Xizan, and the Ying and Shuo deputy military commissioners, the Xi army junior officer Aililixia, the Bohai junior officer Guanhai, and others had defected to Song, their households were registered and distributed among meritorious officers.

sentences.zh: 宋將曹彬、米信北渡拒馬河，與於越休哥對壘，挑戰，南北列營長六七里。

translations.literal: Song generals Cao Bin and Mi Xin crossed north over the Juma River and faced yuyue Xiuge in camp, challenging battle; north and south the camps stretched six or seven li.
translations.idiomatic: Song generals Cao Bin and Mi Xin crossed the Juma River to the north and faced yuyue Xiuge in camp, challenging battle; the opposing camps stretched six or seven li north and south.

sentences.zh: 時上次涿州東五十里。

translations.literal: At that time the Emperor was fifty li east of Zhuo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Emperor was encamped fifty li east of Zhuo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔於越休哥、奚王籌寧、宣徽使蒲領、南北二王等嚴備水道，無使敵兵得潛至涿州。

translations.literal: On jiayin day an edict ordered yuyue Xiuge, Xi King Chouning, Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling, the Northern and Southern Court kings, and others to guard the waterways strictly so that enemy troops could not steal through to Zhuo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day an edict ordered yuyue Xiuge, Xi King Chouning, Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling, the Northern and Southern Court kings, and others to guard the waterways strictly so that enemy troops could not slip through to Zhuo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，休哥等敗宋軍，獻所獲器甲、貨財，賜詔褒美。

translations.literal: On yimao day Xiuge and the others defeated the Song army, presented captured armor, weapons, and goods, and were granted an edict of praise.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Xiuge and the others routed the Song army, presented captured armor, weapons, and goods, and received an edict of commendation.

sentences.zh: 蔚州左右都押衙李存璋、許彥欽等殺節度使蕭啜裏、執監城使、銅州節度使耿紹忠，以城叛，附於宋。

translations.literal: Weizhou left and right chief clerks Li Cunzhang, Xu Yanqin, and others killed military commissioner Xiao Chuoli, seized the city overseer, and took Copper Prefecture military commissioner Geng Shaozhong captive; they rebelled with the city and went over to Song.
translations.idiomatic: Weizhou left and right chief clerks Li Cunzhang and Xu Yanqin and others killed military commissioner Xiao Chuoli, seized the city overseer, and took Copper Prefecture military commissioner Geng Shaozhong captive; they surrendered the city and defected to Song.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，復涿州，告天地。

translations.literal: On bingchen day Zhuo Prefecture was recovered and heaven and earth were notified.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Zhuo Prefecture was recovered and heaven and earth were notified.

sentences.zh: 戊午，上次沙姑河之北澱，召林牙勤德議軍事。

translations.literal: On wuwu day the Emperor halted at the shoal north of the Shagu River and summoned yulin Qinde to discuss military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the Emperor encamped at the shoal north of the Shagu River and summoned yulin Qinde to discuss military affairs.

sentences.zh: 諸將校各以所俘獲來上。

translations.literal: The various officers each presented what they had captured.
translations.idiomatic: Each of the officers presented his captives and booty.

sentences.zh: 奚王籌寧、南北二王率所部將校來朝。

translations.literal: Xi King Chouning and the Northern and Southern Court kings led the officers of their divisions to court.
translations.idiomatic: Xi King Chouning and the Northern and Southern Court kings led the officers of their divisions to court.

sentences.zh: 以近侍粘米裏所進自落鴇祭天地。

translations.literal: A fallen hawk presented by attendant Nianmili was used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: The court sacrificed to heaven and earth with a fallen hawk presented by attendant Nianmili.

sentences.zh: 己未，休哥、蒲領來朝，詔三司給軍前夏衣布。

translations.literal: On jiwei day Xiuge and Puling came to court; an edict ordered the Three Departments to supply summer clothing cloth to the armies at the front.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Xiuge and Puling came to court; an edict ordered the Three Departments to supply summer clothing cloth to the armies at the front.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上朝皇太后。

translations.literal: On gengshen day the Emperor paid court to the Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the Emperor attended court before the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，大軍次固安。

translations.literal: On xinyou day the main army halted at Gu'an.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the main army encamped at Gu'an.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，圍固安城，統軍使頗德先登，城遂破，大縱俘獲。

translations.literal: On renxu day Gu'an city was besieged; army commander Pide was first to ascend the wall, the city was then taken, and captives were released freely.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the army besieged Gu'an; army commander Pide was first over the wall, the city fell, and captives were taken freely.

sentences.zh: 居民先被俘者，命以官物贖之。

translations.literal: Residents who had earlier been taken captive were ordered ransomed with official goods.
translations.idiomatic: Residents who had earlier been taken captive were allowed to ransom themselves with official goods.

sentences.zh: 甲子，賞攻城將士有差。

translations.literal: On jiazi day the troops who stormed the city were rewarded in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the troops who stormed the city were rewarded according to rank.

sentences.zh: 五月庚午，遼師與曹彬、米信戰於歧溝關，大敗之，追至拒馬河，溺死者不可勝紀。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengwu day, the Liao army fought Cao Bin and Mi Xin at Qigou Pass and routed them, pursuing to the Juma River; those who drowned were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengwu day, the Liao army fought Cao Bin and Mi Xin at Qigou Pass and crushed them, pursuing to the Juma River; the drowned were beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 餘眾奔高陽，又為遼師沖擊，死者數萬，棄戈甲若丘陵。

translations.literal: The survivors fled to Gaoyang and were again struck by the Liao army; tens of thousands died and discarded arms and armor like hills.
translations.idiomatic: The survivors fled to Gaoyang and were struck again by the Liao army; tens of thousands died and cast off arms and armor in heaps like hills.

sentences.zh: 免漕數萬人匿歧溝空城中，圍之。

translations.literal: Several tens of thousands of grain-transport conscripts hid in the empty city at Qigou and were surrounded.
translations.idiomatic: Several tens of thousands of grain-transport conscripts hid in the empty city at Qigou and were surrounded.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以皇太后生辰，縱還。

translations.literal: On renshen day, because it was the Empress Dowager's birthday, they were released and allowed to return.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, because it was the Empress Dowager's birthday, the siege was lifted and they were allowed to go.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，班師，還次新城。

translations.literal: On guiyou day the army withdrew and halted again at Xincheng.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the army withdrew and encamped again at Xincheng.

sentences.zh: 休哥、蒲領奏宋兵奔逃者皆殺之。

translations.literal: Xiuge and Puling memorialized that all Song soldiers who fled in flight were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Xiuge and Puling reported that all Song soldiers caught in flight were killed.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以軍捷，遣使分諭諸路京鎮。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, because of the military victory, envoys were dispatched separately to announce it to the various capitals and garrison commands.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, because of the victory, envoys were sent separately to announce it to the various capitals and garrison commands.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔諸將校，論功行賞，無有不實。

translations.literal: On dingchou day an edict ordered the various officers that merit would be assessed and rewards granted without any falsehood.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict ordered the various officers that merit would be assessed and rewards granted without favoritism or false credit.

sentences.zh: 己卯，次固安南，以青牛白馬祭天地。

translations.literal: On jimao day the court halted south of Gu'an and used a green ox and white horse to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day the court encamped south of Gu'an and sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以所俘宋人射鬼箭。

translations.literal: On gengchen day captured Song men were used to shoot ghost arrows.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day captured Song men were used in the ghost-arrow rite.

sentences.zh: 詔遣詳穩排亞率弘義官兵及南北皮室、郎君、拽剌四軍赴應、朔二州界，與惕隱瑤升、招討韓德威等同禦宋兵在山西之未退者。

translations.literal: An edict dispatched xiangwen Paiya to lead Hongyi army troops and the four armies of the Northern and Southern Pishi, langjun, and zhaila to the borders of Ying and Shuo prefectures to join tihu Yaosheng, pacification commissioner Han Dewei, and others in resisting Song troops in Shanxi who had not yet withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent xiangwen Paiya to lead Hongyi army troops and the four armies of the Northern and Southern Pishi, langjun, and zhaila to the borders of Ying and Shuo prefectures to join tihu Yaosheng, pacification commissioner Han Dewei, and others in holding off Song forces in Shanxi that had not yet withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以瑤升軍赴山西。

translations.literal: On xinsi day Yaosheng's army was sent to Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Yaosheng's army was dispatched to Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 壬午，還次南京。

translations.literal: On renwu day the court halted again at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the court encamped again at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 癸未，休哥、籌寧、蒲奴寧進俘獲。

translations.literal: On guiwei day Xiuge, Chouning, and Pununing presented captives.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Xiuge, Chouning, and Pununing presented captives.

sentences.zh: 斜軫遣判官蒲姑奏復蔚州，斬首二萬餘級，乘勝攻下靈丘、飛狐，賜蒲姑酒及銀器。

translations.literal: Xiezhen sent judge Pugu to memorialize the recovery of Weizhou; more than twenty thousand heads were cut off; taking advantage of victory Lingqiu and Feihu were also taken; Pugu was granted wine and silver vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Xiezhen sent judge Pugu to report the recovery of Weizhou; more than twenty thousand heads were taken; pressing the victory, Lingqiu and Feihu were also captured; Pugu was granted wine and silver vessels.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，禦元和殿，大宴從軍將校，封休哥為宋國王，加蒲領、籌寧、蒲奴寧及諸有功將校爵賞有差。

translations.literal: On bingxu day the court attended at Yuanhe Hall and held a great banquet for the officers who had followed the campaign; Xiuge was enfeoffed as King of Song; Puling, Chouning, Pununing, and other meritorious officers were granted titles and rewards in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the court attended at Yuanhe Hall and held a great banquet for the officers who had followed the campaign; Xiuge was enfeoffed King of Song; Puling, Chouning, Pununing, and other meritorious officers received titles and rewards according to rank.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，發南京，詔休哥備器甲，儲粟，侍秋大舉南征。

translations.literal: On dinghai day the court departed Nanjing; an edict ordered Xiuge to prepare armor and weapons, store grain, and wait until autumn for a major southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the court left Nanjing; an edict ordered Xiuge to ready armor and weapons, store grain, and wait until autumn for a major southern campaign.

sentences.zh: 戊子，斜軫奏宋軍復圍蔚州，擊破之。

translations.literal: On wuzi day Xiezhen memorialized that the Song army again besieged Weizhou and was broken and defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Xiezhen reported that the Song army had again besieged Weizhou and was routed.

sentences.zh: 詔以兵授瑤升、韓德威等。

translations.literal: An edict granted troops to Yaosheng, Han Dewei, and others.
translations.idiomatic: An edict assigned troops to Yaosheng, Han Dewei, and others.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以宋兵至平州，瑤升、韓德威不盡追殺，降詔詰責。

translations.literal: On renchen day, because Song troops had reached Ping Prefecture and Yaosheng and Han Dewei had not pursued and killed them to the full, a descending edict rebuked and reproached them.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, because Song troops had reached Ping Prefecture and Yaosheng and Han Dewei had not pursued and destroyed them fully, an edict descended rebuking them.

sentences.zh: 仍諭，據城未降者，必盡掩殺，無使遁逃。

translations.literal: They were also instructed that those who held cities and had not yet submitted must be wholly overrun and killed, with none allowed to escape.
translations.idiomatic: They were also told that any who still held cities and had not submitted must be overrun and killed to the last, with none allowed to escape.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以軍前降卒分賜扈從。

translations.literal: On guisi day surrendered soldiers from the front were distributed separately among the imperial escort.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day surrendered soldiers from the front were distributed among the imperial escort.

sentences.zh: 乙未，賞頗德諸將校士卒。

translations.literal: On yiwei day Pide's officers, soldiers, and troops were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day the officers, soldiers, and troops under Pide were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 六月戊戌朔，詔韓德威赴闕，加統軍使頗德檢校太師。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the wuxu new moon, an edict ordered Han Dewei to come to court; army commander Pide was additionally made honorary Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu new moon of the sixth month an edict ordered Han Dewei to come to court; army commander Pide was additionally granted honorary grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔南京留守休哥遣炮手西助斜軫。

translations.literal: On jiachen day an edict ordered Nanjing regent Xiuge to send artillerymen west to assist Xiezhen.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day an edict ordered Nanjing regent Xiuge to send artillerymen west to assist Xiezhen.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以夷離畢侄裏古部送輜重行宮，暑行日五十里，人馬疲乏，遣使讓之。

translations.literal: On yisi day the yilibi Zheligu division escorted baggage to the mobile palace; marching in summer heat fifty li a day, men and horses were exhausted; envoys were sent to rebuke them.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the yilibi Zheligu division escorted baggage to the mobile palace; forced to march fifty li a day in summer heat, men and horses were exhausted; envoys were sent to rebuke them.

sentences.zh: 丁未，度居庸關。

translations.literal: On dingwei day the court passed Juyong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the court passed through Juyong Pass.

sentences.zh: 壬子，南京留守奏百姓歲輸三司鹽鐵錢，折絹不如直，詔增之。

translations.literal: On renzi day the Nanjing regent memorialized that the people's annual payment of Three Departments salt-and-iron money, when converted to silk, did not equal its value; an edict ordered the amount increased.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day the Nanjing regent reported that the people's annual payment of Three Departments salt-and-iron money, when converted to silk, fell short of its value; an edict ordered the amount increased.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，斜軫奏復寰州。

translations.literal: On jiayin day Xiezhen memorialized the recovery of Huan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Xiezhen reported the recovery of Huan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，皇太妃、諸王、公主迎上嶺表，設禦幄道傍，置景宗御容，率從臣進酒，陳俘獲於前，遂大宴。

translations.literal: On yimao day the imperial consort, princes, and princesses welcomed the Emperor beyond the pass; they set an imperial canopy beside the road, placed Emperor Jingzong's portrait, led the attending ministers in presenting wine, displayed captives before them, and then held a great banquet.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the imperial consort, princes, and princesses welcomed the Emperor beyond the pass; they set an imperial canopy beside the road, placed Emperor Jingzong's portrait, led the attending ministers in presenting wine, displayed captives before them, and then held a great banquet.

sentences.zh: 戊午，幸涼陘。

translations.literal: On wuwu day the court visited Liangyi Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the court went to Liangyi Pass.

sentences.zh: 以所俘分賜皇族及乳母。

translations.literal: Captives were distributed separately among the imperial clan and wet nurses.
translations.idiomatic: Captives were distributed among the imperial clan and wet nurses.

sentences.zh: 己未，聞所遣宣諭回鶻、核列哿國度裏、亞裏等為朮不姑邀留，詔速撒賜朮不姑貨幣，諭以朝廷來遠之意，使者由是乃得行。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, it was learned that the envoys sent to announce and reassure the Uyghur, Heliege guodu Li, Yali, and others had been detained by Zhubugu; an edict ordered Susa to grant Zhubugu goods and coins and explain the court's intent to draw the distant near; the envoys were thereby able to proceed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day word came that envoys sent to announce policy to the Uyghur, Heliege guodu Li, Yali, and others had been detained by Zhubugu; an edict ordered Susa to present Zhubugu with gifts and explain the court's wish to win over distant peoples, and the envoys were then allowed to continue.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以節度使韓毗哥、翰林學士邢抱樸等充雲州宣諭招撫使。

translations.literal: On guihai day, Military Commissioner Han Pige, Hanlin Academician Xing Baopu, and others were appointed Yunzhou Announcement and Pacification commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Military Commissioner Han Pige, Hanlin academician Xing Baopu, and others were appointed Yunzhou announcement and pacification commissioners.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以太尉王八所俘生口分賜趙妃及於越迪輦乙裏婉。

translations.literal: On bingyin day the captives taken by Grand Preceptor Wang Ba were divided and granted to Consort Zhao and yuyue Dilian Yiliwan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the prisoners taken by Grand Preceptor Wang Ba were divided and distributed to Consort Zhao and yuyue Dilian Yiliwan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙子，樞密使斜軫遣侍御涅裏底、幹勤哥奏復朔州，擒宋將楊繼業，及上所獲將校印綬、誥敕，賜涅裏底等酒及銀器。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on bingzi day, Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiezhen sent attendants Nielidi and Gan Qinge to report the recovery of Shuozhou and the capture of Song general Yang Jiye, and to present the seals, cords, patents, and orders taken by the Emperor; Nielidi and others were granted wine and silver vessels.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day in the seventh autumn month Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiezhen sent attendants Nielidi and Gan Qinge to report the recovery of Shuozhou and the capture of Song general Yang Jiye and to present the seals, cords, patents, and orders taken by the Emperor; Nielidi and the others received wine and silver vessels.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以捷告天地。

translations.literal: On xinsi day victory was announced to Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the court announced the victory to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 以宋歸命者二百四十人分賜從臣。

translations.literal: Two hundred forty Song subjects who had submitted were divided and granted to the accompanying ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred forty Song subjects who had submitted were divided among the accompanying ministers.

sentences.zh: 又以殺敵多，詔上京開龍寺建佛事一月，飯僧萬人。

translations.literal: Also, because many enemies had been killed, an edict ordered a Buddhist service for one month at Shangjing's Kailong Monastery and feeding ten thousand monks.
translations.idiomatic: Because so many enemies had been killed, an edict also ordered a month-long Buddhist service at Shangjing's Kailong Monastery and the feeding of ten thousand monks.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，斜軫奏大軍至蔚州，營於州左。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Xiezhen reported that the main army had reached Weizhou and encamped to the left of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Xiezhen reported that the main army had reached Weizhou and encamped west of the prefecture seat.

sentences.zh: 得諜報，敵兵且至，乃設伏以待。

translations.literal: Receiving a spy report that enemy troops were about to arrive, an ambush was set to wait.
translations.idiomatic: On receiving a spy report that enemy troops were approaching, he laid an ambush and waited.

sentences.zh: 敵至，縱兵逆擊，追奔逐北，至飛狐口。

translations.literal: When the enemy arrived, troops were released to counterattack; pursuing the routed foe northward, they reached Flying Fox Pass.
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy arrived he counterattacked, pursued the fleeing force northward, and drove it as far as Flying Fox Pass.

sentences.zh: 遂乘勝鼓行而西。

translations.literal: Then, pressing the advantage, they advanced westward with drums beating.
translations.idiomatic: Then, pressing the advantage, the army advanced westward to the beat of drums.

sentences.zh: 入寰州，殺守城吏卒千餘人。

translations.literal: They entered Huanzhou and killed more than a thousand defending officials and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: They entered Huanzhou and killed more than a thousand defending officials and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 宋將楊繼業初以驍勇自負，號楊無敵，北據雲、朔數州，至是，引兵南出朔州三十里，至狼牙村，惡其名，不進；

translations.literal: Song general Yang Jiye had at first prided himself on martial prowess and was called Yang the Invincible; holding Yun and Shuozhou and several prefectures in the north, at this time he led troops south thirty li from Shuozhou to Langya Village; disliking the name, he would not advance;
translations.idiomatic: Song general Yang Jiye had prided himself on martial prowess and was called Yang the Invincible; holding Yun, Shuozhou, and several northern prefectures, he now led his force thirty li south from Shuozhou to Langya Village, but disliking the name he refused to go farther;

sentences.zh: 左右固請，乃行。

translations.literal: His attendants urgently pleaded, and only then did he proceed.
translations.idiomatic: His attendants pressed him again and again before he went on.

sentences.zh: 遇斜軫，伏四起，中流矢，墮馬被擒。

translations.literal: He encountered Xiezhen; ambushes rose on every side; he was struck by an arrow, fell from his horse, and was captured.
translations.idiomatic: He met Xiezhen; ambushes sprang up on every side; struck by an arrow he fell from his horse and was taken.

sentences.zh: 瘡發不食，三日死。

translations.literal: His wounds festered; he ate nothing and died after three days.
translations.idiomatic: His wounds festered; he took no food and died after three days.

sentences.zh: 遂函其首以獻。

translations.literal: His head was then placed in a box and presented.
translations.idiomatic: His head was then boxed and sent up as tribute.

sentences.zh: 詔詳穩轄麥室傳其首於越休哥，以示諸軍，仍以朔州之捷宣諭南京、平州將吏。

translations.literal: An edict ordered xiangwen Xia Maishi to convey the head to yuyue Xiuge to show the armies and also to announce the Shuozhou victory to the officers of Nanjing and Pingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered xiangwen Xia Maishi to carry the head to yuyue Xiuge for display to the armies and to announce the Shuozhou victory to the officers of Nanjing and Pingzhou.

sentences.zh: 自是宋守雲、應諸州者，聞繼業死，皆棄城遁。

translations.literal: From this time Song defenders of Yun, Ying, and other prefectures, hearing of Jiye's death, all abandoned their cities and fled.
translations.idiomatic: From then on Song defenders of Yun, Ying, and the other prefectures, hearing that Jiye was dead, all abandoned their cities and fled.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉朔，置先離闥覽官六員，領於骨裏、女直、迪烈於等諸部人之隸官籍者。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the dingyou new moon, six xianli talan posts were established to oversee officials on the registers from the Yugu Li, Jurchen, Dilie Yu, and other divisions.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou new moon of the eighth month six xianli talan posts were established to oversee officials on the registers from the Yugu Li, Jurchen, Dilie Yu, and other divisions.

sentences.zh: 以北大王蒲奴寧為山後五州都管。

translations.literal: Northern Great King Pununing was made overseer of the five prefectures west of the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Great King Pununing was appointed overseer of the five prefectures west of the mountains.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，韓德讓奏宋兵所掠州郡，其逃民禾稼，宜募人收獲，以其半給收者，從之。

translations.literal: On yisi day Han Derang memorialized that in prefectures and districts plundered by Song troops the grain left by fleeing commoners should be gathered by recruitment, with half given to the gatherers; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Han Derang memorialized that in prefectures and districts plundered by Song troops grain abandoned by fleeing commoners should be gathered by hired labor, with half given to those who gathered it, and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，斜軫還自軍，獻俘。

translations.literal: On yimao day Xiezhen returned from the army and presented captives.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Xiezhen returned from campaign and presented prisoners.

sentences.zh: 己未，用室昉、韓德讓言，復山西今年租賦。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, acting on the words of Shifang and Han Derang, this year's land tax in Shanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, on the advice of Shifang and Han Derang, this year's land tax in Shanxi was remitted.

sentences.zh: 詔第山西諸將校功過而賞罰之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that the merits and faults of the generals and officers in Shanxi be ranked and rewarded or punished accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the merits and faults of Shanxi generals and officers to be ranked and rewarded or punished accordingly.

sentences.zh: 乙室帳宰相安寧以功過相當，追告身一通；

translations.literal: Yishi tent chancellor Anning, whose merit and fault were equal, had one patent of office revoked;
translations.idiomatic: Yishi tent chancellor Anning, whose merit and fault balanced out, had one patent of office revoked;

sentences.zh: 諦居部節度使佛奴笞五十。

translations.literal: Diju division Military Commissioner Fonu was flogged fifty blows.
translations.idiomatic: Diju division Military Commissioner Fonu was flogged fifty blows.

sentences.zh: 惕隱瑤升、拽剌烈、朔州節度使慎思、應州節度使骨只、雲州節度使化哥、軍校李元迪、蔚州節度使佛留、都監崔其、劉繼琛，皆以聞敵逃遁奪官；

translations.literal: Tihu Yaosheng, zhailie Lie, Shuozhou Military Commissioner Shensi, Yingzhou Military Commissioner Guzhi, Yunzhou Military Commissioner Huage, army officer Li Yuandi, Weizhou Military Commissioner Foliu, overseer Cui Qi, and Liu Jichen all had their offices stripped for fleeing on hearing of the enemy;
translations.idiomatic: Tihu Yaosheng, zhailie Lie, Shuozhou Military Commissioner Shensi, Yingzhou Military Commissioner Guzhi, Yunzhou Military Commissioner Huage, army officer Li Yuandi, Weizhou Military Commissioner Foliu, overseer Cui Qi, and Liu Jichen all lost their posts for fleeing when they heard of the enemy;

sentences.zh: 烈仍配隸本貫；

translations.literal: Lie was further assigned to his native register;
translations.idiomatic: Lie was further assigned to his native register;

sentences.zh: 領國舅軍王六笞五十。

translations.literal: Imperial In-law Army commander Wang Liu was flogged fifty blows.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial In-law Army commander Wang Liu was flogged fifty blows.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以斜軫所部將校前破女直，後有宋捷，第功加賞。

translations.literal: On renxu day the generals and officers under Xiezhen, who had first broken the Jurchen and later won victory over Song, were ranked by merit and given added rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the generals and officers under Xiezhen, who had first defeated the Jurchen and later won victory over Song, were ranked by merit and given added rewards.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，加斜軫守太保。

translations.literal: On guihai day Xiezhen was promoted to Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Xiezhen was promoted to Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅朔，皇太妃以上納後，進衣物、駝馬，以助會親頒賜。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the bingyin new moon, the Grand Consort, having presented gifts after the Empress's investiture, further sent clothing, camels, and horses to assist the marriage gifts and distributions.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin new moon of the ninth month the Grand Consort, having already presented gifts after the Empress's investiture, further sent clothing, camels, and horses to assist the marriage gifts and distributions.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，次黑河，以重九登高於高水南阜，祭天。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day the court halted at Black River; on the Double Ninth it climbed high on the southern hill of Gaoshui and sacrificed to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the court halted at Black River; on the Double Ninth the Emperor climbed the southern hill at Gaoshui and sacrificed to Heaven.

sentences.zh: 賜從臣命婦菊花酒。

translations.literal: Chrysanthemum wine was granted to the accompanying ministers' wives.
translations.idiomatic: Chrysanthemum wine was granted to the wives of the accompanying ministers.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，次河陽北。

translations.literal: On dingchou day the court halted north of Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the court encamped north of Heyang.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，內外命婦進會親禮物。

translations.literal: On wuyin day inner and outer titled ladies presented marriage gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day inner and outer titled ladies presented marriage gifts.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，納皇后蕭氏。

translations.literal: On xinsi day Empress Xiao was invested.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Empress Xiao was invested.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，次儒州，以大軍將南征，詔遣皮室詳穩乞的、郎君拽剌先赴本軍繕甲兵。

translations.literal: On bingxu day the court halted at Ru Prefecture; because the main army was about to campaign south, an edict ordered Pishi xiangwen Qidi and langjun zhailie to go ahead to their armies to repair armor and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the court halted at Ru Prefecture; with the main army preparing to march south, an edict ordered Pishi xiangwen Qidi and langjun zhailie to go ahead to their armies to repair armor and weapons.

sentences.zh: 己丑，召北大王蒲奴寧赴行在所。

translations.literal: On jichou day Northern Great King Pununing was summoned to the imperial camp.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Northern Great King Pununing was summoned to the imperial camp.

sentences.zh: 甲午，皇太后行再生禮。

translations.literal: On jiawu day the Empress Dowager performed the rebirth rite.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the Empress Dowager performed the rebirth rite.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申朔，党項、阻卜遣使來貢。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the bingchen new moon, the Tangut and Zubu sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen new moon of the tenth winter month the Tangut and Zubu sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，皇太后復行再生禮，為帝祭神祈福。

translations.literal: On dingyou day the Empress Dowager again performed the rebirth rite to sacrifice to the spirits and pray for the Emperor's blessing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the Empress Dowager again performed the rebirth rite, sacrificing to the spirits to pray for the Emperor's blessing.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以乙室王帳郎君吳留為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On jihai day Yishi royal tent langjun Wuliu was made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Yishi royal tent langjun Wuliu was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 政事令室昉奏山西四州自宋兵後，人民轉徙，盜賊棄斥，乞下有司禁止。

translations.literal: Chief Councillor Shifang memorialized that since the Song invasion the people of the four Shanxi prefectures had been displaced and bandits had multiplied, and requested that the authorities be ordered to forbid this;
translations.idiomatic: Chief councillor Shifang memorialized that since the Song invasion the people of the four Shanxi prefectures had been displaced and banditry had spread, and asked that the authorities be ordered to suppress it;

sentences.zh: 命新州節度使蒲打裏選人分道巡檢。

translations.literal: Xinzhou Military Commissioner Puda Li was ordered to select men to patrol by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: Xinzhou Military Commissioner Puda Li was ordered to select men to patrol by separate routes.

sentences.zh: 北大王帳郎君曷葛只裏言本府王蒲奴寧十七罪，詔橫帳太保核國底鞫之。

translations.literal: Northern Great King tent langjun Hegu Zhili reported seventeen crimes of his prince Pununing; an edict ordered Horizontal Tent Grand Guardian Heguo to investigate and try him.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Great King tent langjun Hegu Zhili reported seventeen crimes committed by his prince Pununing; an edict ordered Horizontal Tent Grand Guardian Heguo to investigate and try him.

sentences.zh: 蒲奴寧伏其罪十一，笞二十釋之。

translations.literal: Pununing confessed to eleven crimes and was flogged twenty blows and released.
translations.idiomatic: Pununing confessed to eleven of the charges and was flogged twenty blows and released.

sentences.zh: 曷葛只裏亦伏誣告六事，命詳酌罪之。

translations.literal: Hegu Zhili also confessed to six counts of false accusation and was ordered to have his punishment carefully determined.
translations.idiomatic: Hegu Zhili also confessed to six counts of false accusation and was ordered to receive a carefully determined punishment.

sentences.zh: 知事勤德連坐，杖一百，免官。

translations.literal: Clerk Qinde was punished by association: beaten one hundred blows and dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Clerk Qinde was punished by association: beaten one hundred blows and dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，出居庸關。

translations.literal: On jiachen day the court passed out through Juyong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the court passed out through Juyong Pass.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔諸京鎮相次軍行，諸細務權停理問。

translations.literal: On yisi day an edict ordered the various capitals and garrison towns to march in succession with the army and temporarily suspend handling minor affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day an edict ordered the various capitals and garrison towns to march in succession with the army and temporarily suspend routine minor business.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，分遣拽剌沿邊偵候。

translations.literal: On gengxu day zhailie were dispatched along the border to scout.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day zhailie were dispatched along the border to scout.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命皇族廬帳駐東京延芳澱。

translations.literal: On xinhai day the imperial clan's Lu tent was ordered to encamp at Eastern Capital Yanfang Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the imperial clan's Lu tent was ordered to encamp at Eastern Capital Yanfang Marsh.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔以敕榜付於越休哥，以南征諭拒馬河南六州。

translations.literal: On renzi day an edict ordered that an imperial patent be delivered to yuyue Xiuge to announce the southern campaign to the six prefectures south of the Juma River.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day an edict ordered an imperial patent delivered to yuyue Xiuge to announce the southern campaign to the six prefectures south of the Juma River.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，幸南京。

translations.literal: On yimao day he visited Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the Emperor visited Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以南院大王留寧言，復南院部民今年租賦。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, on the word of Southern Court Great King Liuning, this year's land tax of the Southern Court divisions was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, on memorial from Southern Court Great King Liuning, this year's land tax of the Southern Court divisions was remitted.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以銀鼠、青鼠及諸物賜京官、僧道、耆老。

translations.literal: On renxu day silver sable, blue sable, and other goods were granted to capital officials, monks and Daoists, and elders.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day silver sable, blue sable, and other goods were granted to capital officials, monks and Daoists, and elders.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上與大臣分朋擊鞠。

translations.literal: On jiazi day the Emperor and the great ministers divided into teams and played cuju.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Emperor and the great ministers divided into teams and played cuju.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙寅朔，党項來貢。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the bingyin new moon, the Tangut came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin new moon of the eleventh month the Tangut came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以政事令韓德讓守司徒。

translations.literal: On gengwu day Chief Councillor Han Derang was promoted to Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Chief Councillor Han Derang was promoted to Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以古北、松亭、榆關征稅不法，致阻商旅，遣使鞫之。

translations.literal: On renshen day, because levies at Gubei, Songting, and Yugu Pass were unlawful and blocked merchants and travelers, envoys were dispatched to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, because levies at Gubei, Songting, and Yugu Pass were unlawful and blocked merchants and travelers, envoys were sent to investigate.

sentences.zh: 女直請以兵從征，許之。

translations.literal: The Jurchen requested to follow the campaign with troops; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchen asked to follow the campaign with troops, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，禦正殿，大勞南征將校。

translations.literal: On guiyou day he held court in the Main Hall and greatly rewarded the southern campaign generals and officers.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Emperor held court in the Main Hall and greatly rewarded the southern campaign generals and officers.

sentences.zh: 丙子，南伐，次狹底堝，皇太后新閱輜重兵甲。

translations.literal: On bingzi day the southern expedition halted at Xiadi Pass; the Empress Dowager newly inspected the baggage train, armor, and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the southern expedition halted at Xiadi Pass, and the Empress Dowager newly inspected the baggage train, armor, and weapons.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以休哥為先鋒都統。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Xiuge was made vanguard commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Xiuge was appointed vanguard commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，日南至，上率從臣祭酒景宗御容。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, the winter solstice, the Emperor led the accompanying ministers to sacrifice and offer wine before Emperor Jingzong's portrait.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the winter solstice, the Emperor led the accompanying ministers to sacrifice and offer wine before Emperor Jingzong's portrait.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔以北大王蒲奴寧居奉聖州，山西五州公事，並聽與節度使蒲打裏共裁決之。

translations.literal: On xinsi day an edict ordered Northern Great King Pununing to reside at Fengsheng Prefecture and jointly decide all public business of the five Shanxi prefectures with Military Commissioner Puda Li.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day an edict ordered Northern Great King Pununing to reside at Fengsheng Prefecture and jointly decide all public business of the five Shanxi prefectures with Military Commissioner Puda Li.

sentences.zh: 癸未，祭日月，為駙馬都尉勤德祈福。

translations.literal: On guiwei day the sun and moon were sacrificed to to pray for the blessing of Imperial Son-in-law Commander Qinde.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day the court sacrificed to the sun and moon to pray for the blessing of Imperial Son-in-law Commander Qinde.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，置諸部監，勒所部各守營伍，毋相鎮雜。

translations.literal: On yiyou day overseers of the various divisions were established, ordering each division to keep to its own camp and not mix ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day overseers of the various divisions were established, ordering each division to keep to its own camp and not mix ranks.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，遣謀魯姑、蕭繼遠沿邊巡僥。

translations.literal: On bingxu day Molugu and Imperial Son-in-law Xiao Jiyuan were dispatched to patrol the border.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Molugu and Imperial Son-in-law Xiao Jiyuan were dispatched to patrol the border.

sentences.zh: 以所獲宋卒射鬼箭。

translations.literal: Captured Song soldiers were used to shoot ghost arrows.
translations.idiomatic: Captured Song soldiers were used to shoot ghost arrows.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以青牛白馬祭天地。

translations.literal: On dinghai day the blue ox and white horse were sacrificed to Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the court sacrificed the blue ox and white horse to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，次白佛塔川，獲自落馴狐，以為吉征，祭天地。

translations.literal: On xinmao day the court halted at White Pagoda River; a tame fox that had come of itself was taken as a lucky sign, and Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the court halted at White Pagoda River; a tame fox that had come of itself was taken as a lucky sign, and Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 詔駙馬都尉蕭繼遠、林牙謀魯姑、太尉林八等固守封疆，毋漏間諜。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Imperial Son-in-law Xiao Jiyuan, yuyue Molugu, and Grand Preceptor Lin Ba to hold the frontier firm and let no spies slip through.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Imperial Son-in-law Xiao Jiyuan, yuyue Molugu, and Grand Preceptor Lin Ba to hold the frontier firm and let no spies slip through.

sentences.zh: 軍中無故不得馳馬，及縱諸軍殘南境桑果。

translations.literal: In the army no one might gallop without cause, nor might the troops wantonly destroy mulberry trees and fruit in the southern borderlands.
translations.idiomatic: In the army no one might gallop without cause, nor might the troops wantonly destroy mulberry trees and fruit in the southern borderlands.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，至唐興縣。

translations.literal: On renchen day the army reached Tangxing County.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the army reached Tangxing County.

sentences.zh: 時宋軍屯滹沱橋北，選將亂射之，橋不能守，進焚其橋。

translations.literal: At that time Song troops were encamped north of the Hutuo Bridge; selected officers shot at them in disorder; the bridge could not be held, and they advanced and burned it.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Song troops were encamped north of the Hutuo Bridge; selected officers shot at them in disorder; the bridge could not be held, and the Liao force advanced and burned it.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，涉沙河，休哥來議事。

translations.literal: On guisi day they crossed the Sha River; Xiuge came to discuss military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day they crossed the Sha River, and Xiuge came to discuss military affairs.

sentences.zh: 北皮室詳穩排亞獻所獲宋諜二人，上賜衣物，令還招諭泰州。

translations.literal: Northern Pishi xiangwen Paiya presented two captured Song spies; the Emperor granted them clothing and ordered them back to win over Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Pishi xiangwen Paiya presented two captured Song spies; the Emperor granted them clothing and ordered them back to win over Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 楮特部節度使盧補古、都監耶律盼與宋戰於泰州，不利。

translations.literal: Chute division Military Commissioner Lubugu and overseer Yelü Pan fought Song at Taizhou with an unfavorable outcome.
translations.idiomatic: Chute division Military Commissioner Lubugu and overseer Yelü Pan fought Song at Taizhou and were defeated.

sentences.zh: 甲午，祭麃鹿神。

translations.literal: On jiawu day the Milu Spirit was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the court sacrificed to the Milu Spirit.

sentences.zh: 以盧補古臨陣遁逃，奪告身一通；

translations.literal: Because Lubugu had fled in battle, one patent of office was revoked;
translations.idiomatic: Because Lubugu had fled in battle, one patent of office was revoked;

sentences.zh: 其判官、都監各杖之。

translations.literal: his administrative assistant and overseer were each beaten with the staff.
translations.idiomatic: his administrative assistant and overseer were each beaten with the staff.

sentences.zh: 郎君拽剌雙骨裏遇宋先鋒於望都，擒其士卒九人，獲甲馬十一，賜酒及銀器。

translations.literal: Langjun zhailie Shuang Guli encountered Song vanguard at Wangdu, captured nine of their soldiers, and took eleven suits of armor and horses; he was granted wine and silver vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Langjun zhailie Shuang Guli encountered the Song vanguard at Wangdu, captured nine soldiers, and took eleven suits of armor and horses; he received wine and silver vessels.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以盧補古等罪詔諭諸軍。

translations.literal: On yiwei day an edict announced the crimes of Lubugu and others to the armies.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day an edict announced the crimes of Lubugu and others to the armies.

sentences.zh: 以禦盞郎君化哥權楮特部節度使，橫帳郎君佛留為都監，代盧補古。

translations.literal: Yuzhan langjun Huage was made acting Chute division Military Commissioner and Horizontal Tent langjun Foliu overseer, replacing Lubugu.
translations.idiomatic: Yuzhan langjun Huage was made acting Chute division military commissioner and Horizontal Tent langjun Foliu overseer, replacing Lubugu.

sentences.zh: 權領國舅軍桃畏請置二校領散卒，詔以郎君世音、頗德等充。

translations.literal: Acting Imperial In-law Army commander Tao Wei requested that two officers be appointed to command scattered soldiers; an edict appointed langjun Yiyin, Pode, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Imperial In-law Army commander Tao Wei asked that two officers be appointed to command scattered soldiers; an edict appointed langjun Yiyin, Pode, and others.

sentences.zh: 命彰德軍節度使蕭闥覽、將軍迪子略地東路。

translations.literal: Zhangde Army Military Commissioner Xiao Talan and General Dizi were ordered to sweep the eastern route.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangde Army Military Commissioner Xiao Talan and General Dizi were ordered to sweep the eastern route.

sentences.zh: 詔休哥、排亞等議軍事。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Xiuge, Paiya, and others to discuss military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Xiuge, Paiya, and others to discuss military affairs.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥，休哥敗宋軍於望都，遣人獻俘。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jihai day, Xiuge defeated the Song army at Wangdu and sent men to present captives.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day in the twelfth month Xiuge defeated the Song army at Wangdu and sent men to present prisoners.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，營於滹沱北，詔休哥以騎兵絕宋兵，毋令入邢州；

translations.literal: On renyin day the army encamped north of the Hutuo; an edict ordered Xiuge to use cavalry to cut off the Song army and not let it enter Xingzhou;
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the army encamped north of the Hutuo; an edict ordered Xiuge to use cavalry to cut off the Song army and keep it from entering Xingzhou;

sentences.zh: 命太師王六謹偵候。

translations.literal: Grand Preceptor Wang Liu was ordered to scout.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Preceptor Wang Liu was ordered to scout.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，小校曷主遇宋輜重，引兵殺獲甚眾，並焚其芻粟。

translations.literal: On guimao day junior officer He Zhu encountered Song baggage train, led troops to kill and capture in great numbers, and also burned their fodder and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day junior officer He Zhu encountered a Song baggage train, led troops to kill and capture in great numbers, and burned their fodder and grain.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔南大王與休哥合勢進討，宰相安寧領迪離部及三克軍殿。

translations.literal: On jiachen day an edict ordered the Southern Great King to join forces with Xiuge in advance and chancellor Anning to command the Dilie division and the Three Ke armies as rear guard.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day an edict ordered the Southern Great King to join Xiuge in a combined advance and Chancellor Anning to command the Dilie division and the Three Ke armies as rear guard.

sentences.zh: 上率大軍與宋將劉廷讓、李敬源戰於莫州，敗之。

translations.literal: The Emperor led the main army and fought Song generals Liu Tingrang and Li Jingyuan at Mo Prefecture and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor led the main army against Song generals Liu Tingrang and Li Jingyuan at Mo Prefecture and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，擒宋將賀令圖、楊重進等。

translations.literal: On yisi day Song generals He Lingtu and Yang Chongjin and others were captured.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Song generals He Lingtu, Yang Chongjin, and others were captured.

sentences.zh: 國舅詳穩撻烈哥、宮使蕭打裏死之。

translations.literal: Imperial In-law xiangwen Taliege and Palace Attendant Xiao Dali died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial In-law xiangwen Taliege and Palace Attendant Xiao Dali died in battle.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔休哥以下入內殿，賜酒勞之。

translations.literal: On bingwu day an edict ordered Xiuge and those below him to enter the inner hall and granted them wine in reward.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day an edict summoned Xiuge and his subordinates into the inner hall and granted them wine in reward.

sentences.zh: 丁未，築京觀。

translations.literal: On dingwei day a victory mound was built.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day a victory mound was built.

sentences.zh: 復以南京禁軍擊楊團城，守將以城降。

translations.literal: Again the Nanjing Forbidden Army attacked Yang Tuan City, and the defending general surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: The Nanjing Forbidden Army again attacked Yang Tuan City, and the garrison commander surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 詔禁侵掠。

translations.literal: An edict forbade raiding and plunder.
translations.idiomatic: An edict forbade looting.

sentences.zh: 己酉，營神榆村，詔上楊團城粟麥、兵甲之數。

translations.literal: On jiyou day he encamped at Shenyu Village; an edict ordered reports submitted on the amounts of grain and armor and weapons at Yang Tuan City.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the court encamped at Shenyu Village and ordered reports on the grain and arms at Yang Tuan City.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以黑白二牲祭天地。

translations.literal: On xinhai day Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to with black and white victims.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the court sacrificed to Heaven and Earth with black and white victims.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，拔馮母鎮，大縱俘掠。

translations.literal: On guichou day Fengmu Garrison was taken and captive plunder was greatly permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the army took Fengmu Garrison and permitted extensive looting and the taking of captives.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，邢州降。

translations.literal: On bingchen day Xing Prefecture surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Xing Prefecture submitted.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，拔深州，以不即降，誅守將以下，縱兵大掠。

translations.literal: On dingsi day Shen Prefecture was taken; because it did not surrender immediately, the defending general and those below him were executed and the troops were allowed to plunder greatly.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the army stormed Shen Prefecture; because it did not surrender at once, the garrison commander and his subordinates were executed and the troops were turned loose to plunder.

sentences.zh: 李繼遷引五百騎款塞，願婚大國，永作藩輔。

translations.literal: Li Jiqian led five hundred horsemen to pay respects at the border, wished to marry into the great state, and forever serve as a frontier vassal.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jiqian came to the frontier with five hundred horsemen to submit, asked for a marriage alliance with the court, and pledged to serve forever as a border vassal.

sentences.zh: 詔以王子帳節度使耶律襄之女汀封義成公主下嫁，賜馬三千匹。

translations.literal: An edict enfeoffed Ting, daughter of Prince's Tent Military Commissioner Yelü Xiang, as Princess Yicheng and gave her in marriage below, granting three thousand horses.
translations.idiomatic: An edict enfeoffed Ting, daughter of Prince's Tent military commissioner Yelü Xiang, as Princess Yicheng and gave her in marriage to him, with a grant of three thousand horses.
